name: Kling AI (Global)
tagline: Create images and videos with the official Kling AI MCP service
description: Connect to the hosted Kling AI Global MCP service for image and video generation workflows. Sign in with a Global account using OAuth. Generation consumes paid personal-workspace credits; Global and China accounts, credits, and tasks are separate. Available models and parameters depend on the authenticated account. The linked GitHub repository contains a client plugin and Skills, not the hosted server source.

install.notes: After installation, complete OAuth for your Global Kling account. Confirm generation settings before submitting a paid task.
